notes: Arguments are listed in constructor order.
Deploy the Vercel app first, then the contract.
trusted_weather_source must be the exact URL the contract will fetch.

trusted_public_key_modulus is the RSA-2048 public modulus, hex, no 0x prefix. It must correspond to the private key held by the adapter in WEATHER_SIGNING_KEY_PEM, or every observation fails verification.
Coverage window is UTC in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM form and must bracket the period being tested.
threshold_temp is tenths of a degree Celsius: 325 = 32.5C. Use a value below the current temperature to demonstrate the payout path.
After deploying, call get_trusted_weather_source, get_trusted_public_key_modulus and selftest_signature_verification before funding.
The connected wallet must be the one that deployed the policy.
